blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from up to 14,000 ft with views of Lake Michigan and Chicago skyline. The center offers AFF training to earn a solo skydiving license and services for licensed skydivers including coach jumps and gear rentals. Facilities include indoor packing, rigging and repairs, vending machines, and a large landing area with pickup.
extraNote: $39 deposit to book tandem or AFF; balance due on jump day · 100% refundable if paid directly to Skydive Windy City · Reservations highly recommended; walk-ins not guaranteed · No personal cameras allowed on tandem jumps; allowed if experienced with 200+ jumps · Michigan City Municipal Airport
